other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in out-of-fold encoding
other_failure_modes.description: When computing out-of-fold target encodings, global statistics (like the overall mean) used for smoothing are calculated on the entire training dataset rather than just the training folds. This leaks validation target information into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage across cross-validation folds
other_failure_modes.description: Imputation medians, frequency encoding, and groupby aggregations are computed on the entire training dataset before the cross-validation loop. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, resulting in overly optimistic out-of-fold validation scores.

summary: The agent implemented a highly sophisticated pipeline with advanced feature engineering, robust out-of-fold logic, and optimal ensemble blending. However, there are minor issues with peeking at the test set to determine missingness indicators, and moderate data leakage across cross-validation folds due to global statistics being computed on the entire training set before CV splitting.
